name: Wokkpash Valley-MacDonald Creek Loop Trail
quote: The Wokkpash Valley-MacDonald Creek Loop Trail is 70 km in total. Plan to spend five-to-seven days completing the loop.
why: The park's one named trail ("includes a portion of the Wokkpash Valley-MacDonald Creek Loop Trail", bcparks.ca/northern-rocky-mountains-park): a remote 5-7 day trek up the Wokkpash past Forlorn Gorge and back down MacDonald Creek.
note: Multi-day, and not a closed loop: BC Parks starts it 17 km down the Old Churchill Mine Road (from km 645.25 of the Alaska Highway) and ends it at Baba Canyon near km 632; whether the 70 km counts that road is unclear. In OSM it's the Wokkpash Valley Trail (21.6 km, in the park) and the MacDonald Creek Valley Trail (29.8 km, mostly in Stone Mountain Park by OSM's outlines). Routes offers nothing in the park (listed: no routes).
